brief.expectations: This is a single-factor de-grossing of the AI/semi complex, not index-level risk-off: QQQ -1.65% against SPY -0.71% and IWM -0.51%, with TLT flat and GLD -1.42% — no duration bid, no flight-to-quality, just liquidation of the crowded theme after the Amodei-led AI-capability-slowdown headlines, while USO +3.37% marks a separate, unrelated energy shock. The mechanical consequence for an opening-range breakout book is that all 15 candidates are one position: intra-basket correlation today is near 1, so a watchlist of ten names sizes like a single 10x bet on SOX, and a factor reversal hits every leg at once. The second mechanism is opening-range quality — a range printed by forced unwind flow rather than price discovery has a higher false-break rate, with the first push through the range often being the tail of the liquidation rather than continuation, so give-back on the 15:50 flat is the risk, not gap direction. Third, FOMC convenes tomorrow, so short-dated IV carries event premium that will not decay today; the P&L driver is intraday realized-vs-implied on the option leg, and a mid-session grind that stops trending after the 10:15 selection bleeds theta on already-rich contracts.
